visualCharacteristics: Scroll-snap row of photo cards (1 / 2 / 4 visible on mobile / tablet / desktop) with prev/next arrows and page dots. Each card: photo, Basico/Premium plan tags, bold title, short description.
contentPattern: One row per card. Cell 1: photo. Cell 2: paragraph of plan tag links (e.g. Basico, Premium -> #planos), H3 title, description paragraph.
usage: Seguro Protege Casa 'O que o seguro Protege Casa cobre?' coverage cards (Ruptura de tubulacoes hidraulicas, Roubo e subtracao de bens com arrombamento, Vendaval/furacao/ciclone/tornado e granizo, Incendio...).
reuseGuidance: Use for scrollable cards with a photo, optional tag links and a title/description. Tags get a slug class (carousel-coverage-tag-basico, carousel-coverage-tag-premium) for styling. Arrows and dots hide when all cards fit.
